layers.text: Style (exploration concept A, "Phosphor"): vector CRT phosphor display art, like an old oscilloscope or vector arcade monitor. Thin bright glowing green lines (#3dff7a) drawn over near-black green-tinted surfaces (#03110a), outlines only with little or no fill, one hue in two or three brightnesses, a faint soft bloom halo around every line. Hazards may glow amber instead of green. Crisp, minimal, geometric.

Subject: the player robot of a programming puzzle game, seen from high top-down, facing east (to the right). A small cute boxy robot drawn as glowing green line art: a rounded square body outline with a near-black fill, two track outlines along its top and bottom sides, one round glowing sensor eye on the right (east) side, a short antenna. Centered, fills about 75% of the canvas, on a transparent background.
